        <preset/>
        <required_translations>[]</required_translations>
        <script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    /**
     * Handles the certificate auto-renewal execution response.
     * 
     * Processes the renewal result and displays appropriate success/failure alert.
     * On success, resets the renewal form state to defaults.
     * 
     * @param {Object} event - Event object containing renewal response
     * @param {string} [event.payload.data.output.renewal_task_id] - Created task ID on success
     * @param {string} [event.payload.data.output.error] - Error message on failure
     */

    const {
        renewal_task_id,
        error
    } = event.payload.data.output;
    const {
        success,
        failure
    } = api.state.renew_alert_content;

    // Default form state for resetting after successful renewal
    const DEFAULT_RENEW_PAYLOAD = {
        csr_option_selected: 'option1',
        csr_value: '',
        csr_validity_period: 90
    };

    if (error) {
        api.setState('renew_alert', {
            ...api.state.renew_alert,
            type: 'critical',
            header: failure.header,
            message: error,
            show: true,
            action: {
                type: 'dismiss'
            }
        });
        return;
    }

    if (renewal_task_id) {
        // Show success alert with link to the created renewal task
        api.setState('renew_alert', {
            ...api.state.renew_alert,
            type: 'positive',
            header: success.header,
            message: success.message,
            show: true,
            action: {
                type: 'open',
                label: success.label,
                href: renewal_task_id
            }
        });

        // Reset form state to defaults for next renewal attempt
        api.setState('renew_payload', DEFAULT_RENEW_PAYLOAD);

        // Reset CSR validation alert to initial state
        const updatedCsrAlert = [...api.state.validate_csr_alert];
        updatedCsrAlert[0] = {
            ...updatedCsrAlert[0],
            status: 'critical',
            content: 'Invalid CSR'
        };
        api.setState('validate_csr_alert', updatedCsrAlert);
    }
}]]></script>
